verdict_reason: The new proxiedPlantsNotificationApi fixture is unused dead code that duplicates the proxied-context set-up; no functional defect.

todos.issue: proxiedPlantsNotificationApi (lines 9, 19-24) is added but nothing uses it: the only importer of fixtures/security.ts is tests/animals/security/backend/notification-submission.spec.ts, which uses proxiedNotificationApi, and the new tests/plants/security/backend/organisation-scoped-notifications.spec.ts builds its own NotificationApiClient from the plain request fixture (no ZAP proxy). The fixture is dead code, and it also copies the proxied-context set-up from proxiedNotificationApi (lines 15 and 21) for a second home.
todos.fix: Must: fixtures/security.ts declares only fixtures a spec uses, and the ZAP-proxied request context is built in one place. One way: delete proxiedPlantsNotificationApi and the getPlantsBackendBaseUrl import; or, if plants traffic is meant to go through ZAP, have the plants security spec use it and extract a shared proxiedContext helper both fixtures call.
